Driving Licence Apply & Renew — Guide

Last updated: 2026-09-15

Driving Licence (DL) Motor Vehicles Department dwara issue kiya jaata hai aur yeh proof hai ki aap legally vehicle chala sakte hain. Parivahan portal (parivahan.gov.in) se online apply kar sakte hain — pehle Learner's Licence phir Permanent DL.

Simple explanation

Driving Licence ek official document hai jo prove karta hai ki aapne driving test pass kiya hai aur legally road par vehicle chala sakte hain. Bina valid DL ke gaadi chalana illegal hai aur challan / jail dono ho sakta hai.

DL lene ka process 2 steps mein hota hai: Pehle Learner's Licence (LL) milta hai jo 6 months valid hota hai. LL ke kam se kam 30 din baad aap permanent Driving Licence ke liye apply kar sakte hain. Dono ke liye RTO par driving test dena padta hai.

Apply online Parivahan portal (parivahan.gov.in) se hota hai. Form bharein, fees pay karein, aur nearest RTO par slot book karein. Learner's Licence ke liye sirf written test hota hai (traffic rules aur signs). Permanent DL ke liye actual driving test hota hai RTO par.

Driving Licence ki validity 20 saal (18-50 age) ya usse kam hoti hai. 50 saal ke baad 5 saal ki validity hoti hai. Renewal expiry se pehle ya within 1 year of expiry kar sakte hain. Expired DL se gaadi chalana illegal hai.

Why does it matter?

Driving Licence sirf gaadi chalane ke liye hi nahi — yeh ek important government-issued photo ID bhi hai. Address proof ke roop mein bhi kaam aata hai. Insurance claim mein bina valid DL ke claim reject ho sakta hai. Commercial vehicles ke liye toh DL aur bhi critical hai.

Example

In numbers

Aap 18 saal ke ho gaye hain aur scooter seekhna chahte hain. Parivahan portal par jaake Learner's Licence ke liye apply karein (fees ₹150), written test ke liye slot book karein. Test pass karne ke baad LL milta hai. 30 din baad permanent DL ke liye apply karein (fees ₹200), RTO par driving test dein. Test pass — DL 2-3 weeks mein post se aa jaata hai.

Important things to know

  • Learner's Licence pehle banana padta hai — yeh 6 months valid hota hai aur permanent DL ke liye prerequisite hai.
  • Permanent DL ke liye LL ke kam se kam 30 din baad apply kar sakte hain.
  • Parivahan portal (parivahan.gov.in) se online apply hota hai — form, fees, appointment sab online.
  • Written test (LL ke liye): 15 questions mein se 9 correct answer dena zaroori — traffic rules aur signs.
  • Driving test (DL ke liye): RTO par actual vehicle chalana hota hai — track par ya road par.
  • DL validity: 18-50 age = 20 saal ya 50th birthday tak (jo pehle). 50+ age = 5 saal validity.
  • Renewal expiry se 1 saal pehle ya within 1 year of expiry ho sakta hai. 1 saal se zyada expired hai toh dobara test dena pad sakta hai.
  • Vehicle categories alag hain — motorcycle (geared/non-geared), car, commercial vehicle — har category ka alag test.

Common mistakes

  • Learner's Licence ke bina gaadi chalana — LL ke bina practice bhi illegal hai, unless ek permanent DL holder saath baithe.
  • Written test ki tayari na karna — traffic signs aur rules nahi pata toh LL test fail ho jaata hai.
  • RTO test mein nervous hokar galti karna — driving test mein basic controls, signals, parking sab check hota hai. Practice zaroori hai.
  • DL renew karna bhool jaana — expired DL se gaadi chalana illegal hai aur insurance claim bhi reject ho sakta hai.
  • Galat vehicle category select karna — agar aapne non-geared LL banwaya hai toh geared bike nahi chala sakte.

Frequently asked questions

Driving Licence ke liye online apply kaise karein?

Parivahan portal (parivahan.gov.in) par jaayein, apna state select karein, 'Apply for Learner Licence' ya 'Apply for Driving Licence' option chunein. Form bharein, fees online pay karein, RTO par appointment book karein. Test ke din original documents le jaayein.

Learner's Licence kitne din valid rehta hai?

Learner's Licence 6 months ke liye valid hota hai issue date se. Iske andar aapko permanent Driving Licence ke liye apply karna padta hai. LL ke kam se kam 30 din baad hi DL test ke liye eligible hote hain.

Driving Licence ki fees kitni hai?

Learner's Licence: ₹150 (test fees included). Permanent DL (per vehicle class): ₹200. Renewal: ₹200. International Driving Permit: ₹500. Fees state-wise thodi vary kar sakti hai. Parivahan portal par exact fees check karein.

Driving Licence renew kaise karein?

Parivahan portal par 'Apply for Renewal of DL' option select karein. Form bharein, fees pay karein. Medical certificate (Form 1A) lag sakta hai 50+ age ke liye. RTO par jaana zaroori nahi agar biometric already recorded hai. Renewed DL post se aa jaata hai.

Driving test mein kya check hota hai?

Basic vehicle control, start/stop, gears (geared vehicle ke liye), turning, U-turn, parking (reverse aur parallel), traffic signals follow karna, aur road par safe driving. Examiner aapke saath baithta hai aur observe karta hai. Confident aur safe driving dikhana zaroori hai.

Kya main do states se DL banwa sakta hoon?

Nahi — ek person ka ek hi Driving Licence ho sakta hai. Agar aap ek state se doosri state shift hote hain, toh DL transfer karwa sakte hain ya new state mein fresh apply kar sakte hain (purana surrender karke). Multiple DL illegal hain.
